ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation centered around the median notch and extending medially. High-intensity white mottling localized on the lateral halves of both lobes. Right lobe features a large contiguous white polygon with internal dark circular clusters. Left lobe features radial, linear white striations emanating from the center towards the lateral edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 65 degrees; depth is approximately 8% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the majority of the trailing edge. Distinct high-amplitude irregular peaks and jagged topographical breaks at both the far-left and far-right distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric biconcave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convexity in the mid-lobe region before tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) distributed on the dark background of the left lateral lobe. Several dark, roughly elliptical clusters (approx. 15-30 pixels in diameter) located within the white pigmentation of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct dark horizontal linear disruptions observed crossing the white radial pigmentation on the left lobe, indicating unaligned pixel breaks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular calcification or parasitic accumulation (white/tan high-intensity texture) at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; a prominent dark circular lesion is visible in the lower-quadrant of the right lobe white patch.
other_distinctive_markers: Radial brush-stroke effect in the pigmentation of the left lobe, where white intensity pixels follow a specific outward-bound trajectory against the dark base.
